warnings: Axes: x = 1-5 (4.00 + 3.50 + 3.50 + 3.50 = 14.50); y = A-F (3.50 + 2.00 + 3.00 + 2.00 + 1.50 = 12.00). Origin A1. Vector CAD PDF (text drawn as lines, no text layer); S-01..S-05 reprint the same main chains with no conflict.

Dimension sweep covers the S-series read in this op04 pass (S-01..S-08, pages 12-19) plus the ±0.00 datum line of the A-01 notes (page 2). The A-series sheets (A-03 floor plan, A-04 roof plan, A-05..A-09 elevations/sections — they reprint the 1-5 / A-F chains and carry the vertical chain incl. ระดับพื้นห้อง +0.64) were not swept: op04 scope.

Every printed tick is a line (§4 rule 4): S-02 adds x 2.60 and y 7.00; S-03/S-04 add x 2.00, 4.25, 9.25, 10.25, 12.50 and y 2.00, 4.25, 6.50, 10.00; S-05 adds the 1.00 roof overhangs at x -1.00/15.50 and y -1.00/13.00.

y D' (8.85) is the only line not printed anywhere: it is the end of the +5.15 RB1 stub that runs 0.35 past post C1 at D3' on S-04. Measured from the CAD vector geometry (beam end 13.1 pt past the post centre at 1:75), span_source scaled_from_grid on that stub.

S-03/S-04 levels are the view titles (+4.14, +5.29, +6.59) and the S-04 note 'หลังคาน ระดับ +5.15'; they are relative to ±0.00 = ระดับถนนภายในโครงการ (A-01 notes). ระดับดินเดิม (S-06) is not tied to ±0.00 on any swept sheet, so its level_m is null.
